description: Active anomalies in the CANONICAL dataset (correct_image/ + TraceData.xlsx). Historical raw/-only issues are not listed here.

P0002_vs_P0003.description: Both labeled 11 kPa but visually different crops (Lechee vs Mango). Brightness differs by only 2.7 (127.9 vs 130.6) so not a gross error; flagged as data-quality note.

P0677.description: Image is a wide landscape of a harvested paddy field (stubble, mud, trees, sky), not a close-up soil texture. Models trained on macro textures may fail on these wide shots.
P0677.action: flag_in_metadata; consider separate viewpoint bucket in Phase 3

inferred_metadata_images.detail: Not present in TraceData.xlsx. soil_type/crop/land_type inferred from preceding image in same block. All 8 visually confirmed consistent with assigned soil type (visual_inspection_2026-07-08). rain_date/rain_time left empty.

orientation_note.conclusion: Landscape images are INTENTIONALLY shot horizontally (watermark text renders horizontally, proving not OS-rotated). They are valid soil photos. Must be center-cropped to square before model input. Do NOT auto-rotate.
